sourceRecords.description: Ajangiz Town Hall

sourceRecords.name: Uriena
sourceRecords.description: Cultural and Food Association

sourceRecords.name: Saramus Cultural Association
sourceRecords.description: - Raise awareness among individuals and groups about the development of the village. - Encourage participation in society in all areas, promoting the development of social welfare. - Promote activities that foster social growth, both culturally and economically, as well as social cohesion and activities that respect environmental protection. - Protect the traditional environment of the village in terms of the farmhouses and our landscape, not only physically but also socially, taking care of our current heritage.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Bird Center
sourceRecords.description: Urdaibai Bird Centre is a large living museum of nature, open to the public to enjoy the world of birds and their migrations. The facility itself is a unique observatory of the marshlands and is located in the heart of the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. It is a centre managed by the Aranzadi Science Society dedicated to research and scientific dissemination of birds, their migrations and the habitats where they live. Research and dissemination teams come together and coordinate their work so that visitors can be privileged witnesses of the bird projects being carried out.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo Tourist Office
sourceRecords.description: Bermeo Tourist Office

sourceRecords.name: Euskal Herria Museum
sourceRecords.description: The Euskal Herria Museum is dedicated to preserving and disseminating the history, culture and traditions of Euskal Herria. Through its permanent collection and temporary exhibitions, it offers a comprehensive overview of the evolution of the Basque people, from their natural environment to their social, political and cultural development.

sourceRecords.name: Gernika Peace Museum
sourceRecords.description: An interactive museum that, after an introduction to peace, takes us back to 26 April 1937, the day when bombs and fire reduced the streets of the town of Gernika to rubble. It consists of several rooms, as well as moving audiovisual presentations narrated by the survivors of the tragedy themselves.

sourceRecords.name: Fisherman's Museum
sourceRecords.description: This is one of the few museums in the world dedicated exclusively to showcasing the world, life and work of Basque fishermen, describing their lives and customs, their trade unions, the boats and techniques they have used over time for fishing and selling fish. We can also learn about the history of the Euzkadi Auxiliary Navy, whose core members were Basque fishermen.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve Cooperation Council
sourceRecords.description: The Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve Cooperation Council was created by Decree 164/1995, of 14 February, with the aim of acting as a collaborative body for the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve Board. Its main function is to serve as a channel for participation for representative entities from the social, economic and cultural sectors operating within the reserve.

sourceRecords.name: Gernika Gogoratuz
sourceRecords.description: Gernika Gogoratuz is a peace research centre founded in 1987 by unanimous decision of the Basque Parliament, coinciding with the 50th anniversary of the bombing of Gernika. Its name reflects its mission to promote a culture of peace at the local and global levels.

sourceRecords.name: Lurgaia Foundation
sourceRecords.description: The Lurgaia Foundation is a non-profit organisation dedicated to the conservation and management of natural heritage in the Basque Country. Its main objective is the restoration and recovery of ecosystems, with a special focus on native forests and habitats of community interest. Its work in the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve is particularly noteworthy, where it leads projects such as Undabaso, focused on forest regeneration and the protection of native species.

sourceRecords.name: Gautegiz Arteaga Adult Association ‘G.A.H.E.’
sourceRecords.description: G.A.H.E. is an association dedicated to organising cultural, recreational and educational activities for adults in Gautegiz Arteaga. Its aim is to promote the active participation of residents in community life by offering meeting and learning spaces that encourage active ageing and social integration.

sourceRecords.name: Antolinape Cultural Association
sourceRecords.description: Association dedicated to promoting local culture, the Basque language and the traditions of Gautegiz Arteaga. It organises events that encourage community participation and the transmission of popular customs.

sourceRecords.name: Montorrealde Parents' Association
sourceRecords.description: Montorrealde Guraso Elkartea is the association of parents of CEIP Montorre, located in Gautegiz Arteaga. Its main objective is to collaborate with the school in improving the quality of education and the well-being of students. It organises complementary activities, cultural events and social gatherings, encouraging the active participation of families in school life.

sourceRecords.name: Arratzu Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Arratzu Town Council

sourceRecords.name: Group of Giants from Bermeo
sourceRecords.description: In 2002, a pair of giant fishermen were created, named Anton and Josefin. In 2004, a pair of giant Basque farmers were made, named Lorentzo and Mari. Before that, the first pair of cabezudos (big-headed figures) were made alongside the pair of giants, Roke Aguazila and Madalen Añie. Finally, in 2008, the second pair of cabezudos, Tomás Cabo de Mar and Tiadora Atsue, were made. Thus, the Comparsa de Gigantes de Bermeo was born in 2005 with the intention of making the giants and cabezudos dance in the town of Bermeo.

sourceRecords.name: Arrieta Town Hall
sourceRecords.description: Arrieta Town Hall

sourceRecords.name: Bermeotarrak fanfarrea
sourceRecords.description: La Bermeotarrak Fanfarrea is a wind and percussion band that actively participates in celebrations and festivities in Bermeo and neighbouring towns. Its repertoire includes festive and traditional music, providing entertainment at events such as the Madalena festival, the Arrain Azoka and other local festivities.

sourceRecords.name: Senegalese Association NDA WI
sourceRecords.description: Senegalese Association

sourceRecords.name: Berton Bermeo
sourceRecords.description: Founded in 1983 as A.C.B. (Association of Merchants of Bermeo), Berton Bermeo is an association that brings together more than 70 local businesses with the aim of promoting the economic, social and cultural development of the municipality.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo Tuna World Capital (BTWC)
sourceRecords.description: BTWC is an alliance that seeks to involve all key players in the tuna value chain in Bermeo, the Basque Country and internationally. Its objectives include fostering collaboration between science and fishing, promoting knowledge, training and innovation, recovering and disseminating historical heritage, promoting healthier oceans, facilitating cultural exchange and enhancing the economic and social development of Bermeo.

sourceRecords.name: Bostale
sourceRecords.description: The Bermeo Hoteliers Association was founded in August 2012 with the aim of bringing together local hoteliers and working together to address the common challenges and opportunities facing the hospitality sector in our beautiful town.

sourceRecords.name: Gautegiz-Arteaga Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Gautegiz-Arteaga Town Council

actors.name: Department of Social Action - Provincial Council of Bizkaia

sourceRecords.name: Department of Social Action - Provincial Council of Bizkaia
sourceRecords.description: Department responsible for social policies in the Historical Territory of Bizkaia, including care for dependent persons, social inclusion, protection of minors and support for the elderly.

actors.name: Department of Housing and the Urban Agenda - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Housing and the Urban Agenda - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: Responsible for public housing and urban planning policies in the Basque Country.

actors.name: Department of Natural Environment and Agriculture - Bizkaia Provincial Council

sourceRecords.name: Department of Natural Environment and Agriculture - Bizkaia Provincial Council
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for the management and conservation of the protected natural spaces in Bizkaia, as well as the promotion of sustainable agriculture and livestock farming in the territory.

actors.name: Department of Transport, Mobility and Tourism - Provincial Council of Biscay

sourceRecords.name: Department of Transport, Mobility and Tourism - Provincial Council of Biscay
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for the planning and management of public transport, the promotion of sustainable mobility and tourism in Bizkaia.

actors.name: Department of Industry, Energy Transition and Sustainability - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Industry, Energy Transition and Sustainability - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for areas such as innovation and technology, internationalisation of companies, industrial and energy policy, and sustainable development in the Basque Country.

actors.name: Department of Sustainable Mobility - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Sustainable Mobility - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for developing and implementing sustainable mobility policies in the Basque Country. Its functions include the planning and management of transport infrastructures, the promotion of sustainable modes of transport and coordination with other entities to improve mobility in the region.

sourceRecords.name: Euskal Trenbide Sarea (ETS)​
sourceRecords.description: ETS is a public body created by the Basque Government to manage, develop and maintain the railway infrastructure in the Basque Country. Its aim is to promote a balance between modes of transport, favouring those with a lower environmental impact, especially rail transport.

sourceRecords.name: Behargintza Bermeo, Mundaka and Sukarrieta
sourceRecords.description: It is the local development agency that offers comprehensive support to entrepreneurs and companies in the municipalities of Bermeo, Mundaka and Sukarrieta. Its services include advice on the creation and management of companies, training for employment and promotion of economic development in the region of Busturialdea-Urdaibai.

sourceRecords.name: Lanbide Ekimenak​
sourceRecords.description: Centre for Professional Initiatives dedicated to business promotion and job search for unemployed people located in the region of Busturialdea.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo Nautical Fishing CIFP
sourceRecords.description: Public centre specialising in maritime-fishing education. It offers basic, intermediate and advanced training cycles related to navigation, fishing and ship machinery maintenance. Its facilities have advanced simulators and specialised workshops to train students in maritime tasks.

sourceRecords.name: Basque Association of Development Agencies
sourceRecords.description: Association that brings together the development agencies of the Basque Country, acting as a node of connection and articulation between them. Its mission is to promote the socio-economic development of the counties and municipalities to which they belong, facilitating cooperation and the exchange of good practices among the associated agencies.

sourceRecords.name: Gaztedi Busturialdea​
sourceRecords.description: Inter-institutional collaboration programme that seeks to promote youth policies in the Busturialdea-Urdaibai region. Its objective is to develop initiatives that improve the quality of life of young people, encouraging their active participation in society and facilitating their emancipation.

sourceRecords.name: Lantegi Batuak
sourceRecords.description: A non-profit organisation that generates job opportunities adapted to people with disabilities in Bizkaia, with the aim of achieving their maximum development and quality of life. With more than 40 years of experience, it works to achieve a more inclusive and cohesive society.

sourceRecords.name: Lanbide - Basque Employment Service
sourceRecords.description: Body responsible for managing active employment policies and labour intermediation in the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country. Its mission is to improve people's employability, facilitate their integration into the labour market and promote the economic and social development of the region. In addition, Lanbide offers guidance, training and support services to companies in their search for talent.

actors.name: Department of Employment, Social Cohesion and Equality - Provincial Council of Bizkaia

sourceRecords.name: Department of Employment, Social Cohesion and Equality - Provincial Council of Bizkaia
sourceRecords.description: Its main objective is to develop policies in three fundamental areas: employment, social cohesion and equality. Its mission is to ensure that no person in Bizkaia is excluded, marginalised, discriminated against or at risk of social exclusion.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Bermeo Town Council

actors.name: Department of Economic Promotion - Provincial Council of Bizkaia

sourceRecords.name: Department of Economic Promotion - Provincial Council of Bizkaia
sourceRecords.description: It aims to strengthen the positioning of Bizkaia as an innovative, talented, attractive, connected and balanced territory. Its mission is to ensure that Bizkaia has a high capacity to create and maintain quality employment, remaining at the economic and social forefront of Europe.

actors.name: Department of Basque, Culture and Sport - Provincial Council of Biscay

sourceRecords.name: Department of Basque, Culture and Sport - Provincial Council of Biscay
sourceRecords.description: This department works on the transmission, development and promotion of culture, highlighting its social value. It is also committed to the revitalisation of the Basque language as a key element for coexistence.

actors.name: Department of Culture and Linguistic Policy - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Culture and Linguistic Policy - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for promoting and developing Basque culture and language policy, focusing on areas such as libraries, museums, cultural heritage and the promotion of the Basque language.

actors.name: Department of Economy, Labour and Employment - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Economy, Labour and Employment - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: Its functions include the planning and management of economic and financial policy, the promotion of employment, the regulation of labour relations and the promotion of the social economy.

sourceRecords.name: Busturia Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Busturia Town Council

actors.name: Department of Tourism, Trade and Consumer Affairs - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Tourism, Trade and Consumer Affairs - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for designing and implementing policies related to tourism, trade and consumer protection in the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country. Its aim is to promote the sustainable and competitive development of these sectors, while guaranteeing the rights of consumers.

actors.name: Department of Food, Rural Development, Agriculture and Fisheries - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Food, Rural Development, Agriculture and Fisheries - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for designing and implementing policies related to food, rural development, agriculture and fisheries in the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country. Its objective is to promote the sustainable and competitive development of these sectors, while guaranteeing the protection of the environment and the well-being of the rural population.

actors.name: Department of Justice and Human Rights - Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Department of Justice and Human Rights - Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: This department is responsible for policies related to the administration of justice and the promotion and protection of human rights in the Basque Country. Its functions include the management of judicial resources, free legal aid, attention to victims of crime and the development of initiatives that promote coexistence and historical memory.

sourceRecords.name: BBK fundation
sourceRecords.description: The BBK Foundation is a non-profit organization whose main objective is the social and economic development of Bizkaia. Through various initiatives, the foundation promotes education, culture, environmental sustainability and social welfare in the region.

sourceRecords.name: AZTI
sourceRecords.description: AZTI is a technology center specialized in marine sciences and food. Its mission is to promote the sustainable transformation of the marine and food sectors through applied research and innovation. In Urdaibai, AZTI develops projects focused on environmental sustainability, climate change adaptation and local economic development.

actors.name: Ihobe - Public Environmental Management Company of the Basque Government

sourceRecords.name: Ihobe - Public Environmental Management Company of the Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: Ihobe is the Basque Government's public company responsible for implementing environmental policies and promoting sustainability in the Basque Country. Its work covers areas such as climate change, circular economy, biodiversity and environmental education. In Urdaibai, Ihobe leads and coordinates various initiatives focused on environmental conservation and raising public awareness.

sourceRecords.name: Bilbao Bizkaia Water Consortium (CABB)
sourceRecords.description: CABB is a public entity that manages drinking water supply and wastewater treatment in 81 municipalities in Bizkaia, including the Urdaibai region. Its objective is to guarantee an efficient and sustainable service, ensuring the quality and availability of water in the region..​

actors.name: SPRI - Basque Agency for Business Development

sourceRecords.name: SPRI - Basque Agency for Business Development
sourceRecords.description: SPRI is the Basque Government agency responsible for boosting the competitiveness and transformation of Basque companies. It offers support programmes in areas such as innovation, internationalisation, digitalisation, entrepreneurship and sustainability.

sourceRecords.name: TECNALIA
sourceRecords.description: TECNALIA is one of the largest applied research centres in Spain, with a strong focus on technology transfer and innovation for companies and institutions.

sourceRecords.name: University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU)
sourceRecords.description: The UPV/EHU is the main higher education institution in the Basque Country, with a wide range of academic offerings and outstanding research work.

sourceRecords.name: Basque Centre for Climate Change (BC3)​
sourceRecords.description: BC3 is an international centre of excellence based in Leioa, specialising in interdisciplinary climate science. Its mission is to generate useful knowledge for decision-making in sustainability, climate change and ecological transition policies.

actors.name: Neiker - Basque Institute of Agricultural Research

sourceRecords.name: Neiker - Basque Institute of Agricultural Research
sourceRecords.description: Neiker is a public technology centre specialising in agricultural, forestry and environmental research. Its aim is to generate knowledge and innovative solutions for the agri-food sector and the sustainability of the rural environment.

sourceRecords.name: SARETU
sourceRecords.description:
SARETU was born from the commitment of fishermen and sailors to minimise the impact of plastic waste in our seas and working environments.
Thus, its aim is not only to collect and recycle the nets discarded and/or stored in the home ports of the Basque fishing fleet, but to go further and give them a second life, to revalue them.

sourceRecords.name: Datafish Technology Solutions
sourceRecords.description: Datafish is a company specialised in physical observation and electronic monitoring of fishing activity. Its work contributes to the sustainability of the seas by collecting and analysing scientific data to assess fish stocks and certify good practices in the fishing sector.

sourceRecords.name: Jangurie
sourceRecords.description: The aims of the association are to promote the improvement of the management model of school canteens, and to boost the first sector by promoting local, organic and seasonal products.

sourceRecords.name: Basque Water Agency (URA)
sourceRecords.description: URA is the body responsible for water planning and management in the Basque Country. Its mission includes guaranteeing the good ecological status of bodies of water, preventing risks such as flooding and coordinating actions in the field of sanitation and purification.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo & Mundaka Sea Apartments
sourceRecords.description: Private company dedicated to the rental of tourist accommodation in Urdaibai.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Rentals
sourceRecords.description: Private company specialising in the integrated management of tourist accommodation.

sourceRecords.description: Gernika-Lumo Town Council

sourceRecords.name: Egoitz Alai​
sourceRecords.description: Residence with Person-Centred Care (PCC), promoting the autonomy and well-being of residents, with capacity for 62 residents.

sourceRecords.name: Sancti Spiritus
sourceRecords.description: Residential centre for elderly people offering comprehensive care, including medical services, nursing, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, recreational and religious activities, and social support.

sourceRecords.name: Residencia Calzada Foundation
sourceRecords.description: Residential centre for elderly people offering comprehensive care, including medical services, nursing, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, social assistance, recreational and religious activities, and psychological support.

sourceRecords.name: IMQ Igurco Forua Residence
sourceRecords.description: Specialised social and healthcare centre providing comprehensive care for the elderly, offering medical services, rehabilitation, physiotherapy, psychology, occupational therapy and recreational activities.

sourceRecords.name: Mundaka Laguntza Zentroa
sourceRecords.description: Public entity managed by the Provincial Social Welfare Institute (IFAS) of the Provincial Council of Bizkaia, in collaboration with Ospitalarioak Fundazioa Euskadi (formerly Aita Menni). Residential centre specialising in comprehensive care for adults with intellectual disabilities, offering medical services, rehabilitation, physiotherapy, psychology, occupational therapy, and recreational activities.

actors.name: Demiku Association of Retired People of Bermeo

sourceRecords.name: Demiku Association of Retired People of Bermeo
sourceRecords.description: Non-profit association. Organisation dedicated to promoting the social, cultural and recreational well-being of elderly people in Bermeo and the surrounding area.

sourceRecords.name: Erroxape Women's Association
sourceRecords.description: Association dedicated to promoting gender equality, women's empowerment and the visibility of their contributions to society.

sourceRecords.name: Beletxe
sourceRecords.description: This is an association of retired people from Ea, who organise a programme of activities for the village's senior citizens every year, including outings, talks and film screenings.

sourceRecords.name: Ibarrangelu Town Hall
sourceRecords.description: Ibarrangelu Town Hall

sourceRecords.name: Elantxobe Senior Citizens' Association
sourceRecords.description: Non-profit association dedicated to promoting the social, cultural and recreational well-being of elderly people in Elantxobe and the surrounding area.

sourceRecords.name: Itsas Garapen Association
sourceRecords.description: Association that promotes the sustainable development of fishing communities through the implementation of the Participatory Local Development Strategy (EDLP). Its objective is to diversify the blue economy, foster innovation and improve the quality of life in fishing municipalities.

sourceRecords.name: Ibarrangelu Senior Citizens' Association
sourceRecords.description: The Ibarrangelu Senior Citizens' Association was founded in February 1991, although it did not have any members until 1992. It currently has 40 members. Over the years, the association has organised various activities such as excursions and meals, and it is still active today.

sourceRecords.name: Wärtsilä Ibérica S.A
sourceRecords.description: A subsidiary of the Finnish Wärtsilä Group, specialising in technological solutions for the marine and energy sectors. It manufactures engines, propulsion systems and power generation systems, with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation.

sourceRecords.name: Foundation Athletic Club Fundazioa
sourceRecords.description: The Athletic Club Fundazioa Foundation works to contribute to social welfare through sport, culture and inclusion. Its projects focus on three main areas: Community, Inclusion and Culture, using the values of Athletic Club and football as tools for social transformation.

sourceRecords.name: San Pedro Fishermen's Guild
sourceRecords.description: A historic trade association dedicated to artisanal fishing and the preservation of fishing traditions in Bermeo. The San Pedro Fishermen's Guild is an institution with centuries of history that has played a fundamental role in the organisation and regulation of fishing in Bermeo. Currently, in addition to its traditional functions, it manages activities related to the direct sale of fish, cultural tourism and the promotion of sustainable fishing.

sourceRecords.name: Association of Neskatilas of Bermeo
sourceRecords.description: The Neskatilas Association of Bermeo brings together women who perform traditional tasks in the fishing industry, such as unloading fish, selling at the fish market and managing family boats. Its aim is to raise awareness and recognise women's work in small-scale fishing, promoting equality and empowerment for women in this field.

sourceRecords.name: Hello Urdaibai S.L.
sourceRecords.description: Hello Urdaibai S.L. is the first incoming tourism company in the Busturialdea-Urdaibai region. Its aim is to boost tourism in the area through the revitalisation and coordinated promotion of local tourist resources. It offers services to both visitors and tourism agents, encouraging collaboration and training in the sector.

sourceRecords.name: Disbainu S.A.L.
sourceRecords.description: Design and manufacture of custom bathroom mirrors, lighting and accessories

sourceRecords.name: Madariaga S.L.
sourceRecords.description: Operation of businesses and hospitality establishments

sourceRecords.name: Apartamentos Urdaibai S.L.
sourceRecords.description: It is dedicated to the operation of tourist accommodation and other short-stay accommodation. Its main activity is offering tourist stays in the Urdaibai region, especially in Busturia and Bermeo. The company manages several apartments in the area.

sourceRecords.name: Txakoli Amunategi Txakolina S.L.
sourceRecords.description: Family-run winery located in Busturia, dedicated to the production of txakoli under the Bizkaiko Txakolina Designation of Origin. They have been making txakoli in the traditional way for centuries, with the oldest written reference dating back to 1812. Their winery, built in 1849, has been restored and equipped with modern technology for the production of high-quality txakoli.

sourceRecords.name: Kortezubi Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Kortezubi Town Council

sourceRecords.name: Laminados Losal S.A.
sourceRecords.description: It is a company specialising in the manufacture of hot-rolled steel profiles. Its production includes special profiles for various industrial sectors, including automotive, construction, transport, handling and offshore wind energy. It also produces ‘flanged’ profiles, mainly used in shipbuilding and offshore wind platforms.

sourceRecords.name: Exclusivas Gernika S.A.
sourceRecords.description: Company dedicated to the wholesale distribution of food and beverage products in the province of Bizkaia. Its main focus is the Horeca channel (hotels, restaurants, and cafés), representing exclusive and shared brands.

sourceRecords.name: LGK S.L.
sourceRecords.description: Company specialising in transport, logistics and goods storage. It offers national and international distribution services, with its own fleet of 25 trucks and 8,000 m² of warehouse space. It also has 10 loading bays and offers customised services through its Esku Tek platform.

sourceRecords.name: Metaltérmica GAI S.A.
sourceRecords.description: It offers a wide range of thermal and thermochemical treatments for metals, especially aimed at the automotive, machine tool and capital goods sectors.

sourceRecords.name: Transportes Urrutxua S.L.
sourceRecords.description: It is dedicated to general road freight transport. It offers logistics and distribution services at both local and national levels, adapting to the specific needs of its customers. The company has its own fleet and qualified personnel to ensure efficiency and safety in its operations.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Promo-Gestión S.L.
sourceRecords.description: It is dedicated to real estate development, managing projects related to the development and sale of properties in the Urdaibai region. Its activities include land acquisition, planning and execution of construction projects, as well as the marketing of the resulting properties.

sourceRecords.name: Ebaki XXI S.A.
sourceRecords.description: It is dedicated to the comprehensive transformation of wood, from logging to the production of finished products.

sourceRecords.name: Egoin Wood Group
sourceRecords.description: A company specialising in industrialised timber construction, offering comprehensive solutions ranging from engineering and manufacturing to project execution. With over 30 years of experience, it has established itself as one of the leading players in the sector, standing out for its commitment to sustainability, innovation and the use of local timber.

sourceRecords.name: Haziberriak
sourceRecords.description: It is located on an 8-hectare estate that includes pastures, a native forest, fruit tree crops and a farm with sheep, horses, pigs, chickens and ducks. The project focuses on creating an edible forest (food forest) that uses permaculture techniques to regenerate the soil and increase biodiversity. It also aims to be an educational and cultural centre, offering workshops, stays and activities for groups and families.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Surf Center (USC)
sourceRecords.description: The USC offers surf lessons tailored to different levels and ages, providing all the necessary equipment, including boards, wetsuits and insurance. Lessons are held at Laida Beach, a safe area ideal for learning to surf. The school also organises surf camps and complementary activities such as paddle surfing and yoga.

sourceRecords.name: Urgain
sourceRecords.description: Emerging technology company in Busturia, specialising in the use of drones for industrial and environmental applications.

sourceRecords.name: Melodeep
sourceRecords.description: Innovative startup focused on creating immersive sound experiences using advanced technology.

sourceRecords.name: Harri Artean Abentura Parkea
sourceRecords.description: Adventure park located in Busturia, designed to offer fun and educational experiences in a natural setting.

sourceRecords.name: Cikautxo S. Coop.
sourceRecords.description: Industrial cooperative integrated into the MONDRAGON Corporation. Cikautxo specialises in the development and manufacture of rubber and plastic components for sectors such as the automotive industry, household appliances and playgrounds.

sourceRecords.name: Busturialdeko Hitza
sourceRecords.description: Busturialdeko Hitza is a periodical publication in Basque that provides local information and news about daily life in the towns of the Busturialdea region.

sourceRecords.name: Lurdeia
sourceRecords.description: Lurdeia is an eco-friendly rural guest house located on Mount Sollube, in the municipality of Bermeo. Founded over 30 years ago by a group of friends, Lurdeia offers a peaceful space where guests can connect with nature, promoting sustainable and environmentally friendly practices.

sourceRecords.name: Eco Hotel Mundaka
sourceRecords.description: Eco Hotel Mundaka is a sustainable accommodation located in the centre of the fishing village of Mundaka, on the coast of Bizkaia. The hotel occupies a renovated historic building and offers 19 rooms equipped with modern amenities. It stands out for its commitment to the environment, using organic products, renewable energy and sustainable practices in its daily operations.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Experience & Travel​
sourceRecords.description: Urdaibai Experience is a tourism agency based in the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve in Bizkaia. Its mission is to offer authentic experiences that connect visitors with the nature, history, culture and gastronomy of the region. Through guided tours and personalised excursions, they promote ecotourism and sustainability, working with local guides who are passionate about their land.

sourceRecords.name: Növerek Events S.L.
sourceRecords.description: It is a company specialising in the organisation, management and coordination of all types of events, including weddings, corporate events, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, concerts and shows. Founded by sisters Yaiza and Ania Cid Foruria, originally from Gernika-Lumo, the company is characterised by its creative and personalised approach, offering unique experiences tailored to the needs of each client.

sourceRecords.name: Mendata Town Council
sourceRecords.description: Mendata Town Council

sourceRecords.name: Remenetxe Restaurant
sourceRecords.description: Founded in 1987, Remenetxe is a restaurant located in a 19th-century farmhouse in Muxika. It offers traditional Basque cuisine with a focus on local and seasonal products. Its wine cellar houses more than 1,400 wines and is recognised nationally.

sourceRecords.name: Lurre Hurre Association
sourceRecords.description: Founded in 2020 in Bermeo, Lurre Hurre works to promote the social inclusion of migrants in vulnerable situations. Its approach is based on organic farming as a tool for integration, offering training in agricultural work, support with administrative regularisation and social accompaniment.

sourceRecords.name: Bermeo Psychiatric Hospital
sourceRecords.description: The Bermeo Psychiatric Hospital, opened in 1900, is a centre specialising in the care of people with severe and chronic mental disorders. It is part of the Bizkaia Mental Health Network and offers a wide range of care services, including hospitalisation, rehabilitation, and programmes for people with dementia and severe psychiatric disorders.

sourceRecords.name: Hegaluze Bidaiak
sourceRecords.description: It offers boat trips around the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve, allowing tourists to explore the coast and estuary from the sea.

sourceRecords.name: Arroyabe Canning Factory
sourceRecords.description: Conserveras Arroyabe specialises in the production of canned albacore tuna, tuna and other seafood products, with a focus on quality and sustainability. It uses traditional methods to preserve its products, respecting both the fishing process and the production chain.

sourceRecords.name: Echebastar
sourceRecords.description: It has a fleet of six tuna vessels and is dedicated to the capture, deep-freezing and marketing of high-quality tuna. The company promotes sustainable fishing practices and uses deep-freezing technology at -60°C to preserve the freshness and quality of the tuna. In addition, it has diversified its operations into the production of canned and smoked products under the Alakrana brand.

sourceRecords.name: Urremendi
sourceRecords.description: Urremendi is the rural development association of Busturialdea, whose main objective is to promote sustainable development in the region. It acts as a link between public administrations, civil society and economic agents to improve the primary sector, sustainable tourism and the conservation of the natural environment. It also manages rural development programmes and supports entrepreneurship in rural areas.

sourceRecords.name: Atunsa S.A.
sourceRecords.description: Atunsa is a fishing company founded in 1972 with more than 50 years of experience in tuna fishing. It operates a fleet of seven freezer tuna vessels that fish in the Atlantic and Indian oceans. The company is dedicated to the capture, freezing and marketing of tuna, and stands out for its commitment to sustainable fishing and technological innovation in its processes.

sourceRecords.name: Pevasa S.A.
sourceRecords.description: Pevasa is a fishing company founded in 1961, specialising in tuna fishing and freezing. It operates a fleet of six modern freezer tuna vessels that fish in the Atlantic and Indian oceans. The company is dedicated to the capture, freezing and marketing of tuna, and stands out for its commitment to quality and sustainability in its processes.

sourceRecords.name: Sorginorratz Feminist Group
sourceRecords.description: Feminist group in Bermeo that is organised autonomously and through assemblies. It actively participates in the organisation of events and activities related to gender equality and the visibility of feminism in the town.

sourceRecords.name: Norez Bermioko Talde Feministie
sourceRecords.description: A feminist group in Bermeo that is organised autonomously and through assemblies. It focuses on raising awareness and mobilising around feminist issues, organising activities such as assemblies and awareness campaigns.

sourceRecords.name: Greenpeace
sourceRecords.description: International environmental organisation working to protect the environment through direct action, awareness campaigns and political advocacy.

sourceRecords.name: Ortutik Ahora
sourceRecords.description: Ortutik Ahora is an agent of the solidarity economy and agroecology in the Busturialdea region that promotes food sovereignty through organic farming practices, educational activities and agroecological catering services. The organisation works to create a local network of responsible consumption, reducing dependence on global distribution systems and promoting local and sustainable food production.

sourceRecords.name: Ekologistak Martxan
sourceRecords.description: Environmental organisation that promotes the defence of the environment from an eco-social perspective. Its work includes raising environmental awareness, citizen participation, reporting polluting practices and proposing sustainable alternatives.

sourceRecords.name: Morga Town Hall
sourceRecords.description: Morga Town Hall

sourceRecords.name: Eguzki Talde Ekologista
sourceRecords.description: It is an environmental organisation dedicated to defending the environment, raising social awareness and promoting sustainability. Its work includes denouncing projects that it considers harmful to the natural environment, participating in citizen platforms and organising demonstrations to protect areas of high ecological value.

sourceRecords.name: Zain Dezagun Urdaibai
sourceRecords.description: Zain Dezagun Urdaibai was founded on 9 May 1992 in the Seber Altube Auditorium in Gernika. The Founding Assembly was attended by 54 people, all of legal age and residents of different municipalities in the Busturialdea region, all belonging to the geographical area of the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. It emerged in response to social and environmental aggression, as well as institutional neglect suffered by the towns and neighbourhoods of the region during those years. The Zain Dezagun Urdaibai Association defines itself as open and pluralistic, unified and independent, and was created to resume the work begun by Zain Dezagun Busturialdea and later continued by other entities, seeking alternatives to the degradation of the region.

sourceRecords.name: Gernikako Ekologi Lan Taldea (GELT)
sourceRecords.description: Gernikako Ekologi Lan Taldea is one of the most active environmental organisations in the Busturialdea region. Since its foundation, it has worked to raise environmental awareness, promote ecological education and defend the environment in Urdaibai. It has been involved in various campaigns and projects related to biodiversity conservation, ecosystem protection and the promotion of sustainable practices.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibaiko Galtzagorriak
sourceRecords.description: This federation brings together various environmental and cultural associations in the Busturialdea region. Its main objective is to defend and promote the environment in the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. The federation organises and coordinates environmental volunteer projects, awareness campaigns and educational activities related to biodiversity conservation and sustainable development.

sourceRecords.name: Astra Gernika
sourceRecords.description: A self-managed cultural space run by a collective of local associations and young people, Astra Gernika is a multidisciplinary cultural centre located in the former Astra-Unceta y Cía arms factory. After its closure in 1997 and the subsequent renovation of the building, the space was inaugurated in 2012 as a ‘Cultural Creation Factory’. Its aim is to promote culture and the arts in the Busturialdea-Urdaibai region, providing a meeting place and a platform for expression for the community.

sourceRecords.name: UN Etxea
sourceRecords.description: UN Etxea works to promote UNESCO's values and objectives in the Basque Country, focusing on areas such as education, culture, human rights, sustainable development and gender equality. The organisation acts as a platform for collaboration between civil society, public and private institutions, and local communities.

sourceRecords.name: Ekos Estudios Ambientales S.L.U.
sourceRecords.description: Consultancy specialising in studies and projects related to the environment.

sourceRecords.name: Tourdaibai
sourceRecords.description: Association created in 2019 with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism in the Urdaibai region. It brings together various companies in the tourism sector to promote the region as a quality destination that is environmentally friendly and committed to local economic and social development.

sourceRecords.name: Ur Urdaibai
sourceRecords.description: Company specialising in water activities and adventure sports in the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. It offers a wide range of experiences that allow visitors to enjoy the natural environment of the Urdaibai estuary. Its activities include canoeing, canoeing trips, sea kayaking, introductory courses and technical training in kayaking, stand up paddle, routes, rental and guides, coasteering, hiking, among others.

sourceRecords.name: Izkira Urdaibai
sourceRecords.description: Company dedicated to offering nautical experiences in the Urdaibai estuary. Its offerings include boat trips, ferry service between Mundaka, Laida and Sukarrieta, bird watching, snorkelling trips to the island of Ízaro, geological tours and tourist routes. These activities allow visitors to explore the rich biodiversity and cultural heritage of the area.

sourceRecords.name: Auzholan Association
sourceRecords.description: A citizen initiative launched in Busturia with the aim of promoting neighbourhood cooperation and community self-management.

sourceRecords.name: Insurance Brotherhood of Ibarrangelu
sourceRecords.description: Founded in the 19th century, this brotherhood brings together homeowners in Ibarrangelu to offer collective fire insurance. Its aim is to protect the architectural heritage of the municipality, characterised by its traditional wooden farmhouses, from the risk of fire, which has historically been a significant threat in the area. In addition to its insurance function, the brotherhood acts as a meeting place and forum for collaboration between neighbours, promoting solidarity and community well-being.

sourceRecords.name: Oizmendi Telebista
sourceRecords.description: Oizmendi Telebista is the local television channel offering information, entertainment and cultural content focused on the municipalities of the Busturialdea-Urdaibai region.

sourceRecords.description: Amorebieta-Etxano Town Council

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve Service
sourceRecords.description: This is the administrative unit responsible for managing the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. Its work focuses on promoting and protecting the natural and cultural heritage of the reserve, ensuring sustainable management of natural resources and improving the quality of life of its inhabitants.

sourceRecords.name: Provincial Council of Bizkaia
sourceRecords.description: The Provincial Council of Bizkaia is the institution that governs the historical territory of Bizkaia. It is responsible for the administration and management of areas such as finance, social services, infrastructure, the environment, culture and sport, among others. Its mission is to promote the economic, social and cultural development of Bizkaia, ensuring the well-being of its citizens and the sustainability of the territory.

sourceRecords.name: Ekoetxea - Basque Country Biodiversity Centre
sourceRecords.description: Ekoetxea is the Basque Country's network of environmental centres, managed by the Basque Government through its public company Ihobe. Its main objective is to promote environmental awareness and education, offering unique experiences that connect people with nature and encourage sustainable habits in their daily lives. ‘Basque Country Biodiversity Centre’ is its original institutional name and “Ekoetxea Urdaibai” is its current name within the network of environmental facilities.

sourceRecords.name: Basque Government
sourceRecords.description: The Basque Government is the institution that holds executive and administrative powers in the Basque Autonomous Community. It is composed of the Lehendakari (President) and the ministers who head the various departments. Its powers cover areas such as education, health, security, the economy, the environment and culture, among others.

sourceRecords.name: Basquetour - Basque Tourism Agency
sourceRecords.description: Basquetour is the Basque Government's public agency responsible for promoting and developing tourism in the Basque Country. Its mission is to position the Basque Country as a high-quality, sustainable and competitive tourist destination, promoting initiatives that encourage responsible tourism and enhance the cultural and natural heritage of the region.

actors.name: Association of Social Services of Busturialdea

sourceRecords.name: Association of Social Services of Busturialdea
sourceRecords.description: It is an association of several municipalities in the Busturialdea region of Bizkaia, with the aim of jointly managing and coordinating municipal services to improve their efficiency and quality.

sourceRecords.name: BaSOS
sourceRecords.description: Local forestry promotion group in Busturialdea. The association was founded in 2021, when some local residents began to express concern about changes to the landscape in the area. As well as being a fundamental part of our landscape, forests are essential: they are home to many animals and plants, a source of fertile soil and the oxygen we breathe, a storehouse for carbon dioxide and fuel for many homes. Our forests moderate climate change temperatures and ensure the health of rivers and streams, but they also offer us pleasant places for leisure and provide a complementary source of income for forest owners.

sourceRecords.name: Caniche Publishing
sourceRecords.description: Caniche Editorial is a small publishing house specialising in contemporary artistic projects that encompass writing and visual arts such as plastic arts, architecture, photography, installation and performance. In addition to publishing books, they organise exhibitions and ‘assaults’, ephemeral interventions in unconventional spaces.

sourceRecords.name: Ankurkulu
sourceRecords.description: Ankurkulu is the first cooperative housing project based on the transfer of use in the Autonomous Community of the Basque Country. The project is based on a model of self-management and collective ownership, where the homes are owned by the cooperative and transferred to its members for use on a non-profit basis. This model seeks to guarantee access to affordable and stable housing, promoting community life and sustainability.

sourceRecords.name: Ortuberen Lagunak Association
sourceRecords.description: It is dedicated to the recovery, restoration and enhancement of the Ortube, a historic wooden tuna boat from Bermeo. Its main objective is to preserve the town's maritime and fishing heritage, promoting collective memory and cultural identity linked to the sea. The association carries out boat restoration activities, historical documentation and cultural dissemination.

sourceRecords.name: Irrintzi Alaia Dantza Taldea
sourceRecords.description: Irrintzi Alaia Dantza Taldea is an association dedicated to teaching, practising and promoting traditional Basque dance. Based in Busturia, the group actively participates in cultural events and local festivities, promoting the region's intangible heritage through performances and collaborations with other groups.

sourceRecords.name: Euskal Souvenirs
sourceRecords.description: Euskal Souvenirs is a shop specialising in the sale of souvenirs and gifts typical of Euskal Herria. It offers a wide variety of products that reflect Basque cultural identity, including handicrafts, textiles, ceramics, jewellery, books and decorative items. The shop stands out for its personalised service and for offering items that capture the essence of Gernika and Euskal Herria.

sourceRecords.name: BEIBI – Dreams
sourceRecords.description: Shop specialising in personalised gifts for newborns and children. It is a shop of Berton Bermeo.

sourceRecords.name: Tarratadie Josten Dan Etxie
sourceRecords.description: Shop dedicated to the sale of textiles and sewing services, offering customised solutions in dressmaking and alterations. It is a Berton Bermeo business.

sourceRecords.name: Nusadua
sourceRecords.description: Fashion boutique offering a selection of contemporary clothing and accessories for women, combining style and quality. It is a Berton Bermeo store.

sourceRecords.name: IZ Izaskun Zulueta Estetika
sourceRecords.description: Beauty salon offering a variety of beauty and wellness treatments, including facial and body care services. It is a Berton Bermeo business.

sourceRecords.name: Julita Lentzeria
sourceRecords.description: Shop with over 50 years of experience, specialising in corsetry and lingerie for women, men's underwear and pyjamas, as well as baby and children's clothing. It is a Berton Bermeo store.

sourceRecords.name: Gu Zu Bio
sourceRecords.description: Shop selling organic and bulk products, promoting a sustainable and environmentally friendly lifestyle. It is a Berton Bermeo business.

sourceRecords.name: Ideasur
sourceRecords.description: Network of social and community organisations in Busturialdea-Urdaibai that promotes social transformation from a critical and feminist perspective. Its approach is based on collective construction, interculturality, historical memory and social justice.

sourceRecords.name: Gernikatik Mundura
sourceRecords.description: This NGO was founded in 1995. The association brings together people who are concerned about those most in need and who want to work for intercultural understanding and international solidarity. In addition to carrying out awareness-raising activities in Gernika-Lumo, it also supports and finances development projects.

sourceRecords.name: Parte Hartuz
sourceRecords.description: It is a research group that focuses on citizen participation, community action, and social development. Its objective is to generate applied knowledge that drives social transformation processes, especially in urban and rural contexts.

sourceRecords.name: Lurgozo
sourceRecords.description: Lurgozo Kontsumo Ekologikorako Urdaibaiko Elkartea is an initiative by the residents of Urdaibai. Our goal is to promote a community that improves the well-being of the people living in this area. Based on this premise, we also want to promote the ecological balance of our region, support the local socio-economic economy and contribute to the improvement of the environment.

sourceRecords.name: Gernika-Lumo Cultural Centre
sourceRecords.description: It acts as the nerve centre of cultural, social and artistic activity in the municipality and the surrounding area. It functions as a space for production, exhibition and citizen participation, promoting a stable programme of performing arts, cinema, literature, contemporary art and local culture. It is also linked to processes of historical memory, peace and social transformation, in keeping with the symbolic tradition of Gernika.

sourceRecords.name: Mugarik Gabe
sourceRecords.description: He works to defend human rights, social justice, and environmental sustainability. His mission is to promote comprehensive, feminist, equitable, and sustainable human development among peoples, driving social, political, and economic transformation.

sourceRecords.name: Egurrolea S.L.
sourceRecords.description: Egurrolea specialises in the production and sale of wood products.

sourceRecords.name: Olea Constructions
sourceRecords.description: It is a company specialising in all types of building and construction work, with a particular focus on the renovation of traditional farmhouses and the construction of passive single-family homes using lightweight timber framing.

sourceRecords.name: Gernika Assembly Hall
sourceRecords.description:
For centuries Gernika has been the meeting place for the peoples of Bizkaia. In olden times, each parish sent its representatives to discuss the common problems of the Territory. These meetings were held under the Tree of Gernika and were called the General assemblies of Bizkaia. These lasted until 1876, when the old laws which governed life in Bizkaia, the Fueros, were abolished.

After being suspended for 102 years, the General Assemblies were recovered and reinstated in 1979. Thus, the second stage in the life of this territorial institution begins. Different building had been erected around the Tree of Gernika before 1826, when construction of the current Meeting House commenced.

The Assembly House and the Tree of Gernika are presented to us like living symbols of the history of the Basque people. Headquarters of the highest institutional body in Bizkaia, the building rises beside the revered oak tree, a meeting point for all the territories in the Basque Country, united by a single cultural and ethnographic tradition that transcends all kinds of political frontiers.

sourceRecords.name: Gernika Gorria Koop
sourceRecords.description: To market products obtained by member farms, as well as any product resulting from the crop rotation carried out by member farms that use organic farming methods. To market various agricultural inputs linked to the agricultural production process (seeds, fertilisers, plant protection products) and to agricultural mechanisation (lubricants, diesel) for member farms.

sourceRecords.name: Talleria Berri Winery
sourceRecords.description: This is a modern winery dedicated to producing txakoli wine with the Bizkaiko Txakolina Designation of Origin. Founded in 2011 by 17 local producers from the Txorierri and Urdaibai areas, the winery combines tradition and modernity in its winemaking processes. In addition to wine production, it offers wine tourism experiences, including guided tours and tastings.

sourceRecords.name: Guggenheim Urdaibai STOP
sourceRecords.description: Citizens' platform opposing the expansion project of the Guggenheim Museum in the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve

sourceRecords.name: Landabere
sourceRecords.description: They carry out environmental awareness and education work.

actors.name: Board of Trustees of the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve

sourceRecords.name: Board of Trustees of the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve
sourceRecords.description: Created in 1990, the Board is an advisory body attached to the Basque Government's environmental agency. Its main objective is to ensure the conservation and sustainable development of the Urdaibai Reserve, managing its heritage and funds, and promoting regulations and actions that ensure the protection of its natural and cultural values.

sourceRecords.name: Busturialdeako Txistularien Elkartea
sourceRecords.description: The association that gathers the "whistlers" of the region.

sourceRecords.name: Eraman! Jai Alai
sourceRecords.description: A company that organizes sports events of Zesta punta

sourceRecords.name: Arratzu Elkartegia Langunea
sourceRecords.description: Arratzu Elkartegia Langunea is a rural coworking centre designed to promote entrepreneurship and economic activity in rural areas. It offers shared workspaces and support services for entrepreneurs, especially those linked to the primary sector and the social economy.

sourceRecords.name: Urdaibai Dance Club Forua
sourceRecords.description: A dance club created in 1969 and based in Forua

sourceRecords.name: Association of Merchants Gernika
sourceRecords.description: The Gernika-Lumo Merchants, Hoteliers and Companies Association promotes trusted local shopping.

sourceRecords.name: Arkeoagiri Archaeological Association
sourceRecords.description: The AGIRI Archaeological Association is a cultural association primarily responsible for the study, conservation and dissemination of the Cultural and Archaeological Heritage of the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve. It covers the following areas of Cultural and Archaeological Heritage:

sourceRecords.name: Maier S. Coop.
sourceRecords.description: It is the largest company in the region. The Maier cooperative was founded in 1973 and belongs to the MCC group. The company manufactures components and sub-assemblies for the automotive, household appliance and consumer electronics industries.

sourceRecords.name: Barna SA
sourceRecords.description: A company that recovers fish by-products from canning companies, fishmongers and other fishing industries for reuse, thereby minimising the impact on our oceans as much as possible. With this raw material, they collaborate in the manufacture of natural animal feed and high-protein products that are beneficial to animal health.

sourceRecords.name: Sustabiz Foundation
sourceRecords.description: The Sustabiz Foundation is a private, non-profit organisation whose mission is to promote rural sports, Basque pelota and rowing. The Sustabiz Foundation also focuses on creating, advising and analysing projects. Through these tools, it offers better conditions and greater visibility for our sports wherever they are needed.

sourceRecords.name: Nueva Europa S.L
sourceRecords.description: We are a multidisciplinary, local company founded in Gernika-Lumo in 1995. We are a close-knit team of professionals who are innovative, creative and discreet. Our experience covers communication, design and marketing projects; exhibitions and events; sustainable tourism development and grant management for all of the above services.

actors.name: San Isidro Agricultural and Livestock Cooperative

sourceRecords.name: San Isidro Agricultural and Livestock Cooperative
sourceRecords.description: The San Isidro agricultural and livestock cooperative in Gernika-Lumo, Bizkaia, was founded in 1962 by farmers from the URDAIBAI area. In the beginning, 160 enterprising members rented a warehouse next to the Gernika estuary, next to the mill, to supply themselves with feed and fertiliser at the best market price. Today, we have 233 members and, since July 2007, we have been located in the Bekoibarra industrial estate with a 1,000 m² shop, where you can find a wide range of products related to vegetable gardening, livestock farming, gardening, hardware, household goods, and more.

sourceRecords.name: Murueta Shipyards
sourceRecords.description: Founded in 1943, Astilleros de Murueta is a company specialising in the design and construction of high-tech ships, including cargo ships, tugboats, trawlers, fuel supply vessels and offshore units. It has two facilities: one in Erandio (Bilbao Estuary) and another in Murueta (Urdaibai Estuary), employing more than 500 people between its own staff and auxiliary companies.

sourceRecords.name: Gernikazarra History Group
sourceRecords.description: It was founded in 1985 as the result of reflection by a group of people who were sensitive to history and, fundamentally, to the history of Gernika-Lumo, a municipality which, as is well known, lost its personal, written and graphic memory on the tragic day of 26 April 1937 when, in addition to the deaths of many of its residents, more than 75% of the buildings were destroyed by the fire that followed the bombing, including the archives of the Villa Foral, such as the municipal, judicial and ecclesiastical archives, the property registry and various private archives. Only the archives of a few companies in Gernika were saved from the disaster.

sourceRecords.name: Alkartasuna Dance Group
sourceRecords.description: Its main objective is to spread Basque culture through music and dance.

listening.quote: Emon da informazio urbanistikoa, zenbat espazio okupatuko dauen. Ez dala izango munstro bat, bebai egon da informazioa, behintzat nahi duenantzako entzun. Horrelako gauzak bai esan diez, gero beste gauza bat da sinesten dugun ala ez. Pertsona batzuk ez dabe sinesten “de principio”, segun nok esaten dauen ez dot sinistuten. Hau da, koadroak eskegitze duzu horman eta hiru lau buelta ematen duzu. Horretarako ez dugu behar, horretarako badekogu Bilboko Guggenheim. Uste dut nik, baina nik ulertu dutenagatik hau beste gauza bat da, ez dakitena da zer dan. Eta nire moduan pentsatzen dut gehienak. Idea hori da faltatzen dena.

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0138
listening.quote: Es seguro que van a incluir las infraestructuras que son tan, digamos, limitantes para el territorio, pero que venían obligadas a hacer por parte de Diputación desde hace 25 años. Es decir, que lo colocarían como proyecto económico, lo que ya tenía que haber estado respondido e incluso estaba presupuestado en otros momentos que no se ejecutaron en su momento.

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0138
listening.quote: Los resultados turísticos son los que le avalan como apuesta económica para ese tipo de museo. Claro, es que el impacto que tendría en ese camino vecinal es bárbaro, porque expulsaría, como ha ocurrido en el lugar de Gaztelugatxe, del uso local que tenemos los vecinos que digamos, en poca gente que va por ahí, pero muy asiduo y muy querido de la zona. Si tú introduces un factor turístico en oleada que se quiere que se haga una caminata de siete kilómetros, sea en bici o sea o andando, pues realmente excluyes el uso vecinal, sino que ya para ti esto es como ocurrió en Gaztelugatxe.

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0142

Horretarako bebai bizikleta sareak hobetu egingo dira

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0142

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0142
listening.quote: Obra bat egiten denean eta pleguak ateratzen direnean, hori nahiko nahiko zorrotza izaten da, eta hor eskatzen da zer nahi den. Eta hor argi uste dut agertuko dela ba ezin dela kaltegarria izan edo ze gauza izan behar dituen. Orduan, horren aldetik, ez dut uste arazorik egongo denik. Azkenean ontziola horrek hortik itsasontziak ateratzeko, itsasadarrean dragaketak eman dira. Dragaketa horiek azkenean area pilatu dute, lehen harea ez zegoen lekuan. Estuarioa estutu egin da, harea dagoelako eta harea dagoen leku horretan gaur egun, landare inbaditzaileak hasi dira eta ideia da birnaturalizazio horretan bertako landareak egotea eta estuarioa bere lehengo forma hartzea

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0142

listening.title: Listening excerpt · source 0143
listening.quote: Uste dut Guggenheim museoa hemengo eskualdean sobran dekogule, ez dugula behar.
